statement: Pinned rnconrad/WiimoteEmulator sdp.c includes a 217-byte candidate Wii Remote HID report descriptor with independently verified SHA-256 4d40cb52850ded69a8c1474fff35dfd3e102d4b10ad3579258ab37f4a36fb3ef. Its retail-device provenance, physical revision and correspondence to an authenticated retail SDP record are undocumented, and the historical repository has no identified LICENSE file; therefore a *verified retail* descriptor remains unknown. A genuine, shareable, model-identified SDP/HID acquisition with permitted provenance would settle this.

applicability.revision: Launch, early Plus and TR models not measured
applicability.scope: Candidate embedded descriptor exists in pinned historical emulator source. No copied descriptor bytes or physical dump; PR #16 synthetic descriptor differs by top-level page, Array/Variable field flags and speaker report coverage.
